comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This outfit is part of the Fish in the Sea of Wonders and is produced from a R16 sewing recipe that can be found at Ibn in Alexandria after related to the Sea of Wonders. Ingredients:

Platinum Ore x4
Suede x50
Fish-like Phantom Monster's Relic x8

If you unlock and use Tailor's Skills 1 from Boston's Academic Association, then the above ingredients can be reduced by 10%. Consider obtaining that job-related skill as soon as possible if you plan to pursue this and other Sea of Wonders recipes, it will help you immensely. Refining Sewing skill also gives a set chance to conserve ingredients, potentially saving a portion (x1 typically) from being consumed by production and enabling you to use it again for something else.

Stats:

Durability 100
Disguise 30
Defense 60

Reloading +2
Penetration +2
Gunnery +2
EX Effect: Save Sailors against P.Monster R5

It has been confirmed by GMs that all items crafted from Fish-like Phantom Monster's Relic, including this one, are unplunderable. This does not extend to any of Ibn's other available recipes, including Hyper-series cannons. Hope this helps. Cheers.

Credit re: plunder status: [CA]Huseyin_Gazi, [GM]Sheebs
